navidad.title: Christmas Group Menus
navidad.lead: Company meals and groups of friends. Fixed menus per person, designed to enjoy the sea with no surprises on the bill.
navidad.includesText: Includes dessert, bread, aioli and red mojo sauce, water, and 1 drink (soft drink, draft beer or glass of wine). Extra drinks charged separately.
navidad.depositIntro: To secure the date and number of guests, we require a deposit towards the final amount:
navidad.depositNote: This amount is deducted from the total on the day of the event.
navidad.guestsConfirm: The final number of guests must be confirmed at least 72 hours in advance.
navidad.guestsFinalAmount: The final amount is calculated on the confirmed number, even if fewer people attend.
navidad.cancelOk: Cancellation with more than 72h notice: the full deposit is refunded.
navidad.cancelLate: Cancellation with less than 72h notice, or not showing up: the deposit is non-refundable.
navidad.confirmText: Name of the person responsible, contact phone number, date and time, number of guests and chosen menu. The deposit must be paid by card, at least 15 days before the booking date, in person at the venue.
